title: UI-P5 Employee Portal productization dan employee self-service workspaces
businessRules: Employee Portal UI hanya mengubah presentation dan information architecture; employee self-scope, attendance evidence validation, leave/overtime approval, dan payslip publication tetap authoritative di backend.
GPS, selfie, geofence, operationId, employee/company/branch context, dan attendance event tetap dikirim melalui flow API existing tanpa bypass.
Human Stage-20 UAT tidak boleh dihasilkan automated simulation dan uat:candidate:verify tetap fail-closed sampai human evidence sah.
acceptanceCriteria: Reusable EmployeePortalShell tersedia dengan workspace home, attendance, leave, overtime, payslips, history, dan profile.
Route deep-link Employee Portal mempertahankan login/auth refresh contract dan authenticated shell lama yang dibutuhkan browser UAT.
Attendance/cuti/lembur/slip/riwayat memakai API existing dan tidak mengubah server authorization atau approval behavior.
Desktop sidebar dan mobile navigation memberikan progressive disclosure yang konsisten dengan UI productization foundation.
testPlan: Static invariant: TOKO360 HR, Portal Karyawan, Employee Portal authenticated self-service, /employee/me, attendance event, leave/overtime, dan payslip contract tetap ada.
GitHub Full System Simulation untuk Next build, authenticated employee browser runtime, exact-artifact, Stage-20 automated; Human UAT tetap manual.
rollbackPlan: Rollback commit UI-P5 mengembalikan Employee Portal single-surface tanpa mengubah employee/attendance/payroll data.
monitoringPlan: Pantau Employee Portal Next build, authenticated browser runtime, attendance self-service, leave/overtime, payslip, exact-artifact, dan Stage-20 di GitHub.
securityNotes: UI route bukan security boundary; employee token refresh, employee self-scope, tenant/branch, attendance evidence, dan payslip access tetap diverifikasi backend.
